bottom_line: Rivaroxaban monotherapy was noninferior to combination therapy with rivaroxaban plus a single antiplatelet agent for the primary efficacy end point (hazard ratio, 0.72; 95% CI, 0.55 to 0.95).
implications: In this randomized open-label trial, rivaroxaban monotherapy versus rivaroxaban plus a single antiplatelet agent resulted in a lower hazard for the composite efficacy end point (hazard ratio, 0.72; 95% CI, 0.55 to 0.95) while meeting noninferiority (P<0.001), and it reduced major bleeding (1.62% vs. 2.76% per patient-year; hazard ratio, 0.59; 95% CI, 0.39 to 0.89). The trial was stopped early due to increased mortality in the combination-therapy group, and the document notes early termination may overestimate efficacy data.

criticisms.text: Open-label design had potential to introduce bias (though events adjudicated by independent committee unaware of assignments).
criticisms.quote: The open-label design had the potential to intro- duce bias; however, all the events for which medical attention was sought were adjudicated by the members of an independent committee who were unaware of trial-group assignments.

criticisms.text: Relatively high rates of withdrawal of consent and loss to follow-up.
criticisms.quote: There were relatively high rates of withdrawal of consent and loss of patients to follow-up.

criticisms.text: Choice of antiplatelet regimen was at physician discretion, creating uncertainty about applicability to the two combination regimens.
criticisms.quote: The choice of antiplatelet regimen, either aspirin or a P2Y12 inhibitor, was at the discretion of the treating physicians, a factor that makes it uncertain whether the benefit of rivaroxaban monotherapy applies equally to the two combination regimens.

criticisms.text: Early termination due to increased risk of death in combination group may overestimate efficacy data.
criticisms.quote: The early termination of the trial because of an increased risk of death from any cause in the combination-therapy group may overestimate the efficacy data.
